.PROGRAM kartony()
  SPEED 100 ALWAYS
  ACCEL 100 ALWAYS
  DECEL 100 ALWAYS
  .wyswarstwy = 250
  .ilewarstw = 4
; WARSTWA A
  POINT wa_cel[1] = bazapal+TRANS(1000.000,150.000,-250.000,0,0,0)
  POINT wa_cel[2] = bazapal+TRANS(610.000,150.000,-250.000,0,0,0)
  POINT wa_cel[3] = bazapal+TRANS(100.000,700.000,-250.000,90,0,0)
  POINT wa_cel[4] = bazapal+TRANS(749.500,480.250,-250.000,90,0,0)
  FOR .j = 1 TO .ilewarstw
    .z_offset = (.j-1)*.wyswarstwy
    .z_safe = 600+.z_offset
    POINT cel[1] = wa_cel[1]
    POINT cel[2] = wa_cel[2]
    POINT cel[3] = wa_cel[3]
    POINT cel[4] = wa_cel[4]
; CYKL 1
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[1] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[1] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[1] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
; CYKL 2
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[2] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[2] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[2] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
; CYKL 3
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[3] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[3] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[3] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
; CYKL 4
    JMOVE pobierz_najazd
    LMOVE pobierz
    SIGNAL 12,-13
    TWAIT 0.5
    LMOVE pobierz_najazd
    JMOVE SHIFT(cel[4] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[4] BY 0,0,.z_offset)
    SIGNAL -12,13
    TWAIT 0.2
    LMOVE SHIFT(cel[4] BY 0,0,.z_safe)
  END
.END
